title: Bird Island Boat Tours
specs: Guaranteed puffins on all tours from early May until late August
Boat has removable windows for glass-free picture taking in rain or shine
All ages welcome; life jackets available for all sizes
No pets allowed on board due to crew allergies
Boat comfortably seats 30 with max capacity 35
includes: Boat tour on a 37-foot Cape Islander boat with removable windows and open deck space
blurb: Guests take a 2 hour and 45 minute boat tour on a 37-foot Cape Islander boat to the Bird Islands near Cape Breton to see puffins and other birds. The boat has removable windows for picture taking and open deck space. Puffins are guaranteed on tours from early May until late August.
extraNote: $10 per person deposit required upon reservation · Full payment required before departure · Tours may be cancelled due to wind per Transport Canada regulations; notification by email and text · If tour cancelled due to wind, guests receive a credit · Boat tour departure time subject to change without notice
